◆ txSelMask

rlUInt8_t rlTxnBallbreakMonConf_t::txSelMask

TX channel bit mask indicating which of the TX-N monitors have to be updated with the below configurations. Setting a bit to 1 updates the corresponding TX-N monitor to be configured. Bit number TX index b0 Configure TX0 ball-break monitor b1 Configure TX1 ball-break monitor b2 Configure TX2 ball-break monitor b3 Configure TX3 ball-break monitor b7:4 RESERVED.

The TX reflection coefficient's magnitude for each enabled channel is compared against
the threshold given here. The comparison result is part of the monitoring report
message (Error bit is set if the measurement is higher than or equal to this
threshold, with the units of both quantities being the same).
1 LSB = 0.1 dB, signed number
Valid range: -32767 to +32767 (-3276dB to +3276dB)
